cover.title: Emmet Cohen Trio with Georgia Heers
cover.calloutLabel: A note from CEO of Vivo Performing Arts
cover.pressQuote: An obvious heir apparent to the neo-traditional jazz mantle. The New York Times

sections.title: Welcome
body: Pianist Emmet Cohen has a gift—rare in any era—for making a concert ticket feel like a party invitation. His widely beloved Live from Emmet’s Place webcasts, filmed in his Harlem apartment, welcomed millions to jazz with music that’s alive, joyful, and utterly irresistible. When Cohen and his trio play in concert halls, the sound is bigger and more expansive, but the welcome is just as genuine. Joining Cohen’s trio is vocalist Georgia Heers—featured in Broadway’s Good Night, and Good Luck—whose velvety, luminous voice is steeped in jazz tradition yet entirely her own.
